newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 24.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Deputy premier Wu Bangguo says China will further promote the development of major industrial groups to strengthen the competitiness of state enterprises.
- The newly-established China Shipping Group will start operations in July.
- Over 40 large Shanghai firms have invested in Hong Kong and more companies intend to do so.
- BUSINESS NEWS - China's drug smuggling and addiction has become increasingly a problem with 520,000 people registered as drug addicts by the end of 1995.
